bundle_purpose: Comprehensive Milestone 5 & 6 release containing full discrete-event simulator, causal ML pipeline, verified production experiment summaries, horizon sensitivity sweep, automated research report, dual-mode demonstration CLI, pure-Go HTTP web dashboard, and host audit documentation.
milestone_under_review: Milestones 5 & 6 — Final Metrics, Drift Reporting, Timeline Pagination, CORS Hardening, Summary-Only Mode, and Release Audit
verification_scope: Verification of simulation determinism, causal feature extraction, Logistic Regression & Random Forest evaluations across dual scopes (production matrix N=57,062 and pilot N=1,608), verified per-seed drift detection dynamics (27/27 detected, mean delay 1.0 proposal, 4.33% pre-shift FPR, 7.86% post-shift ongoing alarm rate), horizon sensitivity sweep (H=1..5), live and fallback CLI demonstration transcripts, HTTP dashboard with real LogEntry parsing and summary-only production run inspection, strict CORS, and push-only gossip orphan investigation.
toolchain: Go 1.25.1 windows/amd64 (Pure Go standard library, zero external runtime dependencies)
manifest_self_check_policy: BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json is intentionally excluded from its own internal files list to eliminate self-referential hash invalidation. The manifest's external checksum and size are documented in CONTENTS.md and verified at the bundle level via forkrisk_milestone6_final_release.zip.sha256 sidecar.
known_verification_limitations: Raw simulation logs (events.jsonl for 240 runs, ~6.3 GB) are omitted to maintain a practical archive size (< 70 MB). Summary-only inspection is fully supported via metadata.json and run_summary.csv; pilot and demo runs retain full event logs.

Real blockchain cross-validation is documented as a feasibility analysis and metric mapping in docs/real_chain_cross_check.md because the target host environment lacks local Geth and private Hardhat testnets.

excluded_files.reason: Omitted raw production matrix event logs to maintain manageable archive size. Full summary metrics and configuration are preserved in metadata.json and run_summary.csv, with full dashboard summary-only inspection supported.
